# Maria Bonita Restaurant

> Mexican Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Homemade tortillas, authentic salsas and chilled margaritas, with mariachis on Wednesdays and Fridays.

- Phone: (210) 332-5504
- Address: 350 Northaven Dr, San Antonio, TX 78229
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Lunch specials; The Maria Bonita combo; Party room
- Rating: 4.6 from 3834 Google reviews
